barrier.label: I cleared what was in the way
barrier.detail: Krama checks the page and does the step itself.

step.label: I did this step
step.detail: Krama checks the step worked, then goes on.

blocked: That was blocked during the takeover.
conflict: Someone else is already controlling this run, or the takeover ended.
endedIdle: The takeover ended after 5 minutes without input.
stillPaused: The run is still paused: take over again, allow or cancel it.
youControl: You control the page at step {seq}
privacy: What you type goes to the page only; Krama never stores the screen. Only this site and its sign-in pages open here.
surfaceAria: The run's page. Click to focus, then use mouse and keyboard as usual.

manualLogin.timedOut: Login timed out or browser was closed before completing sign-in.
manualLogin.launchFailed: Failed to launch manual login session
manualLogin.title: One-Time Manual Authentication
manualLogin.explainer: You will log in directly in a separate browser window. Krama only saves an encrypted session cookie, never your password.
manualLogin.pending: Waiting for you to complete sign-in in the open browser...
